title: read_wine_bot translations
description: Keys every locales/*.json file must have. Add a key to both properties and required, then to every locale file.

greeting.description: Reply to /start in a private chat, sent with the menu keyboard.

menu.giveaway.description: Menu button that starts a giveaway setup.

menu.language.description: Menu button that shows the language buttons.

language.prompt.description: Reply to the language menu button, shown above the language buttons.

language.selected.description: Sent after a user taps a language button, with the menu keyboard. %[1]s: the chosen language's button label.

giveaway.prompt.description: First setup step: asks the admin to forward the channel post.

giveaway.ask_end_date.description: Setup step: asks for the end date.

giveaway.ask_end_time.description: Setup step: asks for the end time in Kyiv time; the default is a button.

giveaway.ask_winners.description: Setup step: asks for the number of winners; the default is a button.

giveaway.ask_button_text.description: Setup step: asks for the join button text; the default is a button.

giveaway.invalid_date.description: Sent when the end date is not a YYYY-MM-DD date.

giveaway.date_in_past.description: Sent when the end date is before today in Kyiv.

giveaway.invalid_time.description: Sent when the end time is not an HH:MM time.

giveaway.time_in_past.description: Sent when the end date and time are not in the future.

giveaway.invalid_winners.description: Sent when the number of winners is not a whole number from 1 to 100.

giveaway.invalid_button_text.description: Sent when the join button text is empty or longer than 64 characters.

giveaway.summary.description: Last setup step, shown above Confirm and Cancel. %[1]s: t.me link to the post, %[2]s: end date and time, %[3]d: winners, %[4]s: join button text.

giveaway.confirm.description: Button under the summary that creates the giveaway.

giveaway.cancel.description: Button under every setup step that discards the setup.

giveaway.cancelled.description: Sent after the admin cancels the setup.

giveaway.outdated.description: Popup when a setup button belongs to a step that has passed.

giveaway.created.description: Sent after the join button is attached and the giveaway is saved.

giveaway.exists.description: Sent when a giveaway already runs on the forwarded post.

giveaway.not_admin.description: Sent when the forwarder is not an admin of the post's channel.

giveaway.no_rights.description: Sent when the bot cannot edit the post; names the admin right the bot needs.

giveaway.failed.description: Sent when the setup fails for another reason.

giveaway.button.description: Default label of the join button under the channel post.

giveaway.joined.description: Popup after a user taps the join button for the first time.

giveaway.already_joined.description: Popup after a user taps the join button again.

giveaway.join_failed.description: Popup when the tap could not be recorded.
